implemented.profile: Immutable exact canonical geometry contract, input/guide file identities, coordinate identities and texture checkpoint/config/source pins; consumers reauthenticate the object rather than trusting a name or row count.
implemented.inputs: Actual existing latent reader and ten-tensor geometry reader reopen original saved files. Four original BF16 payload views, exact expanded comparison masks and original C2S child order are preserved. Texture decoder source/config/header are inspected without importing the loader or reading tensor weights.
implemented.guide_validator: Original source-pinned validator runs in its private fixed brick namespace. Exact before/after pairing validates all eight real C2S calls and final coordinate order, refusing cache reuse, mask changes, row changes, stage changes and missing calls.
implemented.private_loader: Compiles exact SHA-verified source bytes. Explicit per-module import mapping and private registrations preserve any generic admission/run_contract module globals.
implemented.persistence: The actual unchanged field writer and independent NumPy reader run in separate pinned private modules, with exactly the fixed authenticated brick byte bounds. A canonical profile document string and hash bind both header and sidecar provenance. Production mode requires the complete original coordinate payload hash. Explicit synthetic fixture mode remains separate.
implemented.historical_defaults: No-profile historical fixture behavior remains unchanged; original sources and original module row constants remain unchanged. Profile-bound artifacts require reader opt-in even for tiny fixture counts.
implemented.filesystem: Original alias, single-link, ownership capability, outside-Git confinement, exclusive creation, exact payload/hash/statistics, finite-value and unclamped F32 transform checks execute unchanged. No stand-in ownership capability is accepted.

synthetic_full_support.numeric_payload: Explicit deterministic finite synthetic raw values, exact unclamped raw * F32(.5) + F32(.5); genuine original coordinate order.
